<thought>We will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, form a carbon‑carbon double bond. This matches the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction. We'll use the product SMILES as the molecule to filter applicable templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
